title: Mayurbhanj · Forest, Rhythm and a Meal — illustrated trail candidate

authorization.context: Founder selected the proposed Mayurbhanj illustrated chapters, forest and performance planning, matching tour books and local contribution prompts.

scope: Three photographed chapters: Similipal forest, Mayurbhanj Chhau and a Baripada Mudhi Mansa meal.
Existing five-idea starter retained; new plans opt into matching chapters without changing old journeys.
Selected chapters and credited photographs carried into offline books; day selection, removed ideas and private-note exclusion respected.
Forest-access and performer-led contribution prompts added alongside food contributions; draft review and explicit public GitHub submission preserved.
Current forest notices, gateway/stay comparison and agreed performance dates treated as separate planning questions; no guaranteed one-day itinerary.

source_checks.title: Similipal Tiger Reserve · Plan your visit
source_checks.note: Official visit guidance inspected on 4 October 2026 for gates, permissions and separate stay/safari arrangements. Exact opening follows dated notices; the displayed 2025 opening announcement does not establish a 2026 reopening. Food guidance has inconsistent wording, so no permission to carry or eat meat inside the reserve is inferred.

source_checks.title: Similipal Tiger Reserve · 2026 monsoon closure notice
source_checks.note: Official notice rechecked on 4 October 2026: monsoon closure from 29 June 2026, except Jamuani and Talabandha ecotourism complexes; reopening to be announced separately. This dated notice is not presented as a live availability feed.

source_checks.title: UNESCO · Chhau dance
source_checks.note: UNESCO’s indexed inscription description rechecked on 4 October 2026. Mayurbhanj is the unmasked style among three Chhau traditions. The inscription is cultural context, not evidence of a scheduled performance.

source_checks.title: Odisha Tourism · Baripada
source_checks.note: Reused the project’s 1 October 2026 review of official indexed tourism text for Baripada’s association with Mudhi Mansa. No new menu, kitchen or origin claim.

image_basis: Three existing licensed photographs: Barehipani waterfall, Mayurbhanj Chhau performers and a home-cooked chicken Mudhi Mansa variation. Existing book-photo mappings and source records reused. No image generation or modification.

design_learning: A regional story can connect a forest, performance and meal while keeping their access and timing independent. A dated cultural photograph supports discovery without becoming an event calendar.
limitations: No new browser visual, interactive, physical-device or native PDF pass; the prior administrator-enforced browser security-policy verification failure remains unresolved.
